features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.desc: You choose a technique: Colossus Slayer (once per turn, +1d8 damage to a target missing any of its Hit Points) or Horde Breaker (once per turn, one of your attacks is repeated against another target within 5 feet of the first).

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.desc: You choose Escape the Horde (Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage) or Multiattack Defense (after a creature hits you, it has Disadvantage on attacks against you until the end of the turn).

features.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
features.desc: Your Hunter's Prey techniques improve: Colossus Slayer triggers on two different targets per turn; Horde Breaker repeats each attack against an adjacent target.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.desc: As a Reaction when you take damage, you reduce it by 1d8 + your Ranger level and gain Resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn.
